startup_idea: I want to build an AI-powered platform that helps small restaurants predict food demand and reduce food waste.

idea_analysis.problem: Small restaurants struggle to predict food demand, resulting in overproduction and significant food waste.

idea_analysis.business_model: Subscription-based SaaS model with tiered pricing for varying levels of service and support
idea_analysis.key_value_proposition: Reduced food waste, improved inventory management, and increased profitability through data-driven decision making
